items.source: Returns whether supplying values for the properties returned via getInputProperties() is sufficient to create a working proxy instance.
items.translation: 返回通过getInputProperties() 返回的属性提供值是否足以创建一个可工作的代理实例。

items.source: Returns whether supplying values for the properties returned via getInputProperties() is sufficient to create a working proxy instance. This will usually be used to determine whether the projection uses any dynamically resolved properties.
items.translation: 返回通过getInputProperties() 返回的属性提供值是否足以创建一个可工作的代理实例。这通常用于确定投影是否使用了任何动态解析的属性。

items.source:
Returns whether the projection has input properties. Projections without input types are typically open projections
that do not follow Java's property accessor naming.
items.translation: 返回投影是否具有输入属性。没有输入类型的投影通常是开放投影，不遵循 Java 的属性访问器命名约定。
